summary.tldr: Requires flight attendants to be paid for pre- and post-flight duties, mandatory training, and certain time on call, at no less than their regular wage.
what_it_does: Counts pre-flight and post-flight duties as paid work for flight attendants, including aircraft security, passenger service, boarding, leaving the aircraft, and safety checks.
Counts time spent completing mandatory training programs as paid work.
Counts time when a flight attendant is at the workplace, at the employer’s call and disposal, including during a flight delay, as paid work.
Requires employers to pay flight attendants at least their regular wage for the work covered by these rules.
summary.background: It adds a new Division I.01 to the Canada Labour Code for flight attendants.
